text: dsh-cinematic-wallpaper（DSH 插件，网页客户端）：为 DSH 网页加入电影式开场动画与动态会话壁纸。它通过 web profile 挂载，在页面载入时呈现开场，再把背景留在界面后方，并让界面文字颜色适配背景。用户可在设置页选择内置或自选开场与背景，还能调整媒体来源。适合希望个性化 DSH 网页外观的用户。需要 DSH web profile；自选媒体由本机媒体目录提供。

dsh-cinematic-wallpaper adds a cinematic intro and animated wallpaper to DSH web. It mounts through the web profile, then places the background behind the UI and adapts text colors to it. Users choose built-in or personal media in settings. Requires DSH web; personal media is read locally.
想给 DSH 网页换成会动的背景壁纸。
Can I add a cinematic opening animation to the DSH web interface?
我想在设置里挑自己的开场视频和背景图片。
dsh-cinematic-wallpaper 的功能「开场与壁纸」：在 DSH 网页载入时显示动画开场，随后将背景画布放到界面后方，并适配界面主题颜色。
dsh-cinematic-wallpaper 的功能「选择媒体」：设置页提供开场和背景选项，可选择内置画面或媒体目录中的视频、图片；选择保存在插件设置命名空间。
dsh-cinematic-wallpaper 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 18 天；提交数 18；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-cinematic-wallpaper README · dsh-cinematic-wallpaper：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) web plugin. Every time the page opens, a character awakens in a 7-second cinematic intro; then the scene settles behind the DSH UI as an animated session wallpaper, and the UI's text colours adapt to whatever is behind them.

dsh-cinematic-wallpaper README · What it does：- **Intro (7 s).**
  - The first 2.7 s play the film's line-art beat (light strands, wireframe, face scan). It comes from a cut-out clip whose baked-in HUD has been removed frame by frame.
  - From there the animation is code-driven: the eye opens, the iris flares green, the camera pushes in.
  - The HUD (logo, wordmark, status list, terminal, corner marks) is drawn in code.
  - Click, or press any key (IME input included), to skip. Keys pressed during the intro never reach the composer.
- **Handoff (0.9 s).** The left HUD fades out and the DSH UI fades in.
- **Session wallpaper.**
  - The character stays behind the UI, with the right-hand corner marks.
  - An AI-generated idle loop plays over it: the hair sways at half speed, played forward then back, about 24 s per cycle.
  - The canvas redraws at most 30 fps while the loop plays, and 10 fps without it.
- **Translucent UI.** There is no fog over the wallpaper in either theme. DSH's surfaces follow its theme as translucent layers, the composer especially so: 28 % opaque in the light theme, 30 % in the dark one.

dsh-cinematic-wallpaper README · Install：Requires DSH `>= 0.1.5-rc.1` and its web profile.

From the release package (prebuilt, includes the two videos):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/zus12873/dsh-cinematic-wallpaper/releases/latest/download/dsh-cinematic-wallpaper.tgz
dsh web
```

Restart `dsh web` after installing or updating. Check that the host half is mounted:

```bash
curl http://127.0.0.1:3080/dsh-cinematic-wallpaper/health
```

Uninstall:

dsh-cinematic-wallpaper README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-cinematic-wallpaper
```

This plugin covers the same ground as boot-animation and wallpaper plugins, and with one of those installed the two stack on top of each other. Remove them while using this one.
dsh-cinematic-wallpaper README · Switching the intro and background：The DeepSeek intro and wallpaper are the defaults. Either can be replaced with your own media, and the intro can be turned off.

dsh-cinematic-wallpaper README · Switching the intro and background：1. Put the files in the media folder, `~/.dsh/dsh-cinematic-wallpaper/media/`. The folder is created the first time the settings tab reads it.
   - Videos: `.mp4`, `.m4v`, `.webm`. A video can be the intro or the background.
   - Images: `.jpg`, `.jpeg`, `.png`, `.webp`. An image can only be the background.
   - Copy the files in: only plain files directly in the folder are listed, not symlinks or sub-folders.
   - To use another folder, set the host plugin option `mediaDir` to an absolute path or `~/…`. A relative path is ignored (with a warning) and the default folder is used.
2. Open **Settings → Plugins → Intro & background** and pick a card under **Intro** and under **Background**. Press **Refresh** after adding files.

dsh-cinematic-wallpaper README · Switching the intro and background：- **When it applies.** The background switches at once, with a crossfade. A new intro applies the next time DSH opens.
- **A file that goes missing.** If the chosen file is gone or can't be played, the intro is skipped and DSH opens straight to its UI, and the background falls back to DeepSeek's. The tab marks a chosen file that is no longer in the folder **File missing**.
- **Limits.** Your own intro and background play muted. They fill the window (cover-fit, centred), so the edges of media with a different aspect ratio are cropped.
- **DSH version.** This needs a DSH whose settings service lets a plugin register its own namespace (verified on DSH 0.1.5-rc.2). DSH 0.1.7 and later may not; there the tab says it can't save these settings and locks its cards, and the plugin keeps the DeepSeek defaults. A save the host refuses for any other reason shows "Couldn't save" and puts the stored choice back.

dsh-cinematic-wallpaper README · Build from source：```bash
git clone https://github.com/zus12873/dsh-cinematic-wallpaper.git
cd dsh-cinematic-wallpaper
npm ci
npm run build

The two videos (`assets/clip.mp4`, `assets/loop.mp4`) are not in Git. Without them the plugin still runs, but without the line-art beat and the idle loop. To get them, take them from the release package:

dsh-cinematic-wallpaper README · Build from source：```bash
curl -L -o /tmp/dcw.tgz https://github.com/zus12873/dsh-cinematic-wallpaper/releases/latest/download/dsh-cinematic-wallpaper.tgz
tar -xzf /tmp/dcw.tgz -C assets --strip-components=2 package/assets/clip.mp4 package/assets/loop.mp4
```
dsh-cinematic-wallpaper README · Change the HUD layout：Run `npm run build` and restart `dsh web` after a change.

dsh-cinematic-wallpaper README · Development：```bash
npm run dev   # http://127.0.0.1:5181
```

- `/?mode=play&t=3.0`: scrub or play the intro.
- `/?mode=compare&t=3.0`: the code render and the source film side by side.
- `/?mode=mock`: the real runtime over a stand-in DSH shell (handoff, theme tokens, keys).

`play` and `compare` overlay the source film from `.cache/reference.mp4`, which `authoring.measure --proxy` makes from it.

dsh-cinematic-wallpaper README · Regenerating the assets：The pipeline in `authoring/` is Python, run through [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/). It does two things:

- turns the source film into the plate, the closed-eye patch, the manifest and the line-art clip;
- turns an AI-generated idle clip into the loop.

The hand-measured values in `authoring/regions.py` belong to that one film, and neither the film nor the idle clip is distributed, so the pipeline is only useful with the same sources:

dsh-cinematic-wallpaper README · Regenerating the assets：```bash
uv run --group authoring python -m authoring.build_assets --video <film.mp4> --out assets --debug .cache/debug
uv run --group authoring python -m authoring.build_loop --source <idle-clip.mp4> --out assets
uv run --group authoring python -m authoring.fonts --out assets/fonts
```

dsh-cinematic-wallpaper README · Tests：```bash
npm test && npm run typecheck
INTRO_FILM=<film.mp4> IDLE_CLIP=<idle-clip.mp4> uv run --group authoring pytest authoring/tests -q
```

Tests that need the film or the idle clip are skipped when those variables are not set.
